document-staged.reason: R12: files chosen but not yet prepared are the upload panel one step later, so it keeps the upload's stack of document types.

document-error.reason: R12: a file that could not be prepared returns the visitor to the upload panel, so it keeps the upload's stack of document types.

document-too-long.reason: R12: an over-limit selection is the same picker with too much ticked, so it keeps the picker's highlighting art.

document-expired.reason: R12: an expired preview is the same picker after its reading time ends, so it keeps the picker's highlighting art.

ocr-too-many.reason: R12: more pages than today's allowance is the same scan review with its action blocked, so it keeps the scanner art.

ocr-paused.reason: R12: paused scanning is the same scan review offering paste instead, so it keeps the scanner art.
